KeystillTyping studio

Privacy policy

Updated November 19, 2026.

During a test

Your browser calculates speed, checks letters and generates the optional PNG. Keystill keeps the typed passage and missed-word list in page memory. Reloading ends the session. The practice code does not send keystrokes to a server.

Saved history

This browser keeps up to 50 completed results in local storage, including date, mode, duration, target, speed and accuracy. Anyone using the same browser profile can see its history. Open History and choose Clear saved history to delete it. Downloaded images remain in your downloads until you remove them.

Hosting and external links

Your browser contacts the hosting provider to load the website. Ordinary requests can expose technical information such as your IP address and browser type to that provider. GitHub handles information you choose to share when reporting a problem there.

Advertising

This version includes no advertising or analytics scripts. If Google AdSense is enabled in a future version, Google and other vendors may use cookies and information about visits to this and other websites to select ads. The policy and applicable consent controls should reflect the providers active at that time.

Google ad personalization settings · Participating vendors’ opt-out choices

Contact the maintainer about a privacy question.
